title: A formally smooth local homomorphism of Noetherian local rings is flat
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that formal smoothness of a local homomorphism of Noetherian local rings in the maximal-adic topology forces flatness. The proof first passes to completions, using that flatness of the completed map descends along the faithfully flat completion maps. In the complete case the author chooses the standard diagram of a power series ring over a Cohen ring mapping compatibly to the two rings, notes that the induced map from the base changed power series ring to the target has a section because the target is formally smooth over the source, and concludes that the target is a direct summand of a flat module, hence flat.
